Name: Rice Expansion
Author: strawhatwem
Description:
This mod adds two new crops (Black Rice and Glutinous Rice), as well as numerous new recipes that use the beloved rice! 

Disclaimer: this is probably not balanced well...if you'd like any price changes, just let me know lol. 

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50830/50830-1787099620-808666668.png[/img]
[list]
[*]The name of vanilla Rice has been changed to White Rice[/*]
[*]When you mill Unmilled Rice, it produces Brown Rice. [/*]
[*]Milling Brown Rice will produce White Rice. [/*]
[*]The Maki Roll recipe has been changed to use White, Brown, or Black Rice. [/*]
[/list]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50830/50830-1787099312-1367968166.png[/img]

New crops: 
[list=1]
[*]Black Rice - Spring[/*]
[*]Glutinous Rice - Summer[/*]
[/list]Both seeds can be bought at Pierre's.

There are 20 true recipes added by this mod. However, you can make a few other items using the Mill, Keg, and Preserves Jar. 

All [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/MizuJakkaru/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=name]Cornucopia [/url]mods[b] except for More Flowers[/b] are recommended for more detailed recipes! Will probably be really unbalanced though. (Again, leave a note if there are price changes you'd like)

[b]Mill:[/b]
[list]
[*]When you mill Unmilled Rice, it produces Brown Rice. [/*]
[*]Milling Brown Rice will produce White Rice. [/*]
[/list][spoiler]Mill Unmilled Black Rice for Black Rice.
Mill Unmilled Glutinous Rice for Glutinous Rice. 
Mill Glutinous Rice for Glutinous Rice Flour. [/spoiler]
[b]Keg:[/b]
[spoiler]Put in a Bag of Genmaicha to make Genmaicha (tea). Takes 3 hours.[/spoiler]
[b]Preserves Jar:[/b]
[spoiler]Put a Duck Egg in to make Salted Duck Egg. Takes 5 days. 
Put in Glutinous Rice to make Jiu Niang. Takes 4 days.[/spoiler]
